biology: Host: trees of the chinquapin genus.
soldier: The soldier has the head capsule pale yellowish brown, the frontal region yellowish brown, mandibles deep brown tinged with red, labrum, anteclypeus and antennae white, pronotum the same colour as the back of the head, abdomen pale yellow; the whole body with short sparse hairs. Head cylindrical, slightly less high than wide, the sides expanding backwards, the posterior margin broadly rounded; the frontal angle slightly projecting, with six to seven shallow longitudinal striae on it, the frontal surface slightly depressed, the Y-shaped suture not visible, the frontal slope nearly 80 degrees, the eye spots almost impossible to discern. Labrum nearly circular. Mandibles rather short, the left mandible less than half as long as the head capsule. Antennae with nine segments, the second shortest. Postmentum short and broad, the margins slightly darker, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The anterior margin of the pronotum shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave.
taxonomy_note: In the original work the genus name is spelled Glyptotermese; the name now in use is Glyptotermes, the genus to which the species belongs.
